usage: Usually refers to the tuba, the large low brass instrument in an orchestra or band.
Common in formal music contexts, especially when talking about orchestras, concert bands, and brass sections.
Can be used on its own or with a classifier like 一個/支 when counting the instrument.
For learners, this is a fairly standard musical term; in everyday speech, people may also just say the English loanword 'tuba' in some contexts.
